thread:
Alex H: Hey team — need approval flow help. Candidate Priya K for Senior Infra Engineer. We want to offer USD 230000 + 18% equity (4y) but comp band for the role tops at 200000. Priya has a competing counteroffer, asking for 220k cash. Can we do an exception and also confirm an accelerated start date of 2025-06-02?
Maria R: Thanks Alex. Quick Q: is 230k total cash or base+bonus?
Alex H: 230k total base. Bonus is standard 10%. Recruiting thinks base is the blocker.
Maria R: Got it. I’ll kick off the comp-exception routing. Heads up: comp exceptions at this level need Compensation, HRBP, and Finance/CFO sign-off per policy. I can start the approval request.
Jamal M: Also want to note Priya needs to start earlier because her current employer asked her to give 2 weeks and wants a June 2nd start. Is payroll okay with that lead time?
Payroll Team: @Jamal M generally we need candidate docs + I9/ID verification and payroll setup at least 5 business days prior to start to guarantee first paycheck alignment. June 2nd is tight but doable if offer is accepted by EOD Friday and we have signed forms.
Sophia (HRBP): For the exception, please attach the candidate comp compa-ratio, market intel, and counteroffer details. Also include business justification: critical infra hire and oncall gap.
Alex H: Copy. I'll add market comps and a short justification paragraph. Maria, can you route to Lisa for comp signoff?
Maria R: Yep. Using our approval tool now. @offer-bot please create a comp-exception request: role=Senior Infra Engineer, candidate=Priya K, requested_base=230000, band_top=200000, justification="critical infra hire, immediate production rollout dependency", start_request=2025-06-02, recruiter=Maria R, hiring_manager=Alex H
offer-bot: Comp-exception request created (REQ-2025-1784). Routing: Lisa (Comp) -> Sophia (HRBP) -> Finance (CFO) -> Legal (FYI). Estimated SLA: 48 hours.
Lisa (Comp): Reviewing. Need Priya's current total comp, counteroffer text, and why 15%+ over band is warranted. Also equity ask? You mentioned 18% — that scale seems off for this role, can you confirm?
Alex H: Sorry typo on equity. It's 0.18% (18 basis points), vesting 4y with 1y cliff. Current comp (from offer packet) = 210k base, 10% bonus, sign-on 15k. Counteroffer from current employer is 220k base.
Lisa (Comp): Thanks. I’ll provisionally approve up to 225k pending CFO signoff if business justification is strong. Please include specific deliverables Priya will own in first 90 days.
Sophia (HRBP): FYI we will need to confirm manager 90-day review and potential promo path documented as part of approval. Also confirm whether relocation or remote stipend applies.
Alex H: Priya is fully remote (US), no relocation. 90-day plan: lead on KV cache improvements, shard migration, and oncall triage — will share bullet list in the request.
Maria R: Uploaded docs: offer packet, counteroffer screenshot, 90-day plan, and market comp spreadsheet to the request. Forwarded to Finance.
Payroll Team: Note for June 2 start, candidate must complete background check clearance and submit banking info by Friday. Background vendor ETA 2-3 business days.
Lisa (Comp): CFO wants to see the ROI estimate and risk if we don't hire. @Finance (CFO) please advise.
Jamal M: Short ROI: 3-week deployment acceleration for infra rollout, reduce expected incident MTTR by ~20% — will add numbers to the request.
Finance (CFO): @Lisa (Comp) reviewing now. Given the caller risk and market tightness, willing to approve up to 230k base plus standard equity. We need a legal skim and payroll timeline confirmation.
offer-bot: REQ-2025-1784 status update: Approved by Lisa (Comp) and Finance (CFO). Pending HRBP confirmation and Legal FYI.
Sophia (HRBP): I confirm. Marking HRBP approved. Legal FYI acknowledged.
Maria R: Great — final step: do we need an exec signature or is CFO approval sufficient per policy?
Lisa (Comp): CFO approval is sufficient for this exception. I'll mark `approved` and Maria can finalize the offer letter.
Maria R: Sending offer now with start date 2025-06-02 and base 230000, bonus 10%, equity 0.18%, sign-on 15k. Added onboarding checklist for payroll.
Alex H: Thank you!! Will coordinate with Priya on start logistics.
Priya K (via Maria R): verbal acceptance this morning, requested to confirm offer in writing and start 2025-06-02.
Payroll Team: Received signed offer? Please upload ASAP so we can start payroll setup.
Maria R: Uploading signed offer and forms to HRIS and triggering background check.
Payroll Team: All set — onboarding tasks scheduled and first payroll alignment confirmed.
Alex H: Appreciate the quick turnaround. :partyparrot:
Maria R: Filing REQ-2025-1784 closure notes and saving docs to candidate record. If any post-hire comp adjustments are needed, open a new case.
Jamal M: Noted. See you on the 2nd, Priya!
Maria R: Closing thread.
